name: Sankt Ingbert (Germany)
description: Horizontally divided black over red, charged at the centre with the city arms of Sankt Ingbert (a lion on lozengy, a wheel and a miner).
history: Municipal flag of St. Ingbert; German municipalities use their flags alongside the arms, the hoisted form (Hissflagge) and the hanging banner (Banner) sharing the same design.

features.role: Sankt Ingbert arms — lion, wheel and miner
